_notes: Dataset IDs and filter column names are best-effort and MUST be confirmed with scripts/verify_datasets.py and scripts/profile_raw.py before relying on them.
Filters use Socrata SoQL syntax. Borough is coded differently across datasets (BK, BROOKLYN, 3).
Set enabled=false for anything not needed yet; Sprint 1 loads the core set only.

pluto.description: City Planning lot-level data (PLUTO): the property spine

dob_permit_issuance.description: Buildings Department permits issued (older BIS system)

dob_job_filings_legacy.description: Buildings Department job application filings (older BIS system)

dobnow_job_filings.description: Buildings Department job filings (newer DOB NOW system)

dobnow_approved_permits.description: Buildings Department approved permits (newer DOB NOW system)

ecb_violations.description: Environmental control board violations issued by Buildings (with penalties)

hpd_violations.description: Housing Preservation and Development housing code violations

hpd_registrations.description: Housing Preservation and Development building registrations

hpd_registration_contacts.description: Owner and managing agent contacts for HPD registrations (joins on registrationid; no borough column)

acris_master.description: ACRIS real property master: one row per recorded document (deeds, mortgages)

acris_legals.description: ACRIS real property legals: which lots each document covers

acris_parties.description: ACRIS parties (buyers, sellers, lenders). Very large and has no borough column; load in Sprint 2 filtered to Brooklyn document IDs.

dof_annualized_sales.description: Department of Finance citywide annualized sales. ID and borough filter verified 2026-11-17.

dob_complaints.description: Buildings Department complaints received (includes stop-work related dispositions). No borough column; Brooklyn community boards start with 3.
